notes: Question paper and answer book are scanned (no text layer); read from page images. Memo has text. Totals check: 150. Most 'fits' marks (50) rely on RE-AUTHORING memo working as number-only steps (e.g. 3.6, 4.5, 4.8, 8.4); memo method marks like 'substitution' map to an intermediate number. Memos give alternative methods (4.8 has five, 3.6/4.5/10.x two or three); steps locks one route, so a correct alternative route is marked wrong. Consistent accuracy is applied across parts (1.2 uses 1.1, 3.7 uses 3.1/3.6, 11.2.4/11.2.5 reuse 11.2.2); steps follow-through is within one part only. Geometry (Q9-11, 41 marks) splits into reason picker on numeric steps (14), full proof builder (23) and a coefficient-template area ratio (4); reasons need one shared theorem-reason list, and statements need numbered-angle hotspots (O2, S1), which letter hotspots do not cover. Trig identities/expressions (Q5-6) need multi-line symbolic working: the single biggest gap (26 marks). Cheaper bridges at lower cognitive demand: mcq for single-statement answers (7.3, 7.4, 5.2.2, 11.2.2 = 5 marks); order with partial credit (Parsons-style) for identity/geometry proofs. Fractions (2/3, 11/4, 9/16, -4/3) would be entered as decimals in num; exact-fraction entry would be better. Q1.1 and Q2.2 need calculator statistics (regression, sigma); not verified whether the app keypad has a stats mode. 7.5 depends on the learner's own 7.2 sketch as context; the app can only show f.
